info.description: API for managing blips, technologies, users, and user technologies
info.title: Tech Radar API

post.description: Authenticate user and return JWT token
Logout current user (client should discard token)
Create a new user account and return authentication token

get.description: Verify that the JWT token is valid and has not been tampered with
List public radars whose owners opted into the gallery. No authentication required.

post.description: Merge technologies from a viewable radar or a template into the caller's radar. Technologies already on the radar are skipped and keep their ring.
Create a new 6-character share code for the authenticated user, or return existing one
post.summary: Create or get existing share code

get.description: Get the authenticated user's share code

patch.description: Set the authenticated user's radar to public (anyone with the link) or private (only listed viewers), and optionally list a public radar in the gallery via listed

get.description: List the usernames allowed to view the authenticated user's private radar

post.description: Add a viewer by username. Adding an existing viewer succeeds.
post.summary: Allow a user to view my private radar

delete.summary: Remove a viewer from my private radar

get.description: Get the full radar graph for a share code. Public radars need no auth; private radars require a bearer token for an allowed user.
get.summary: Get radar graph by share code

delete.description: Delete a share code by code value

post.description: Create a new technology (automatically creates a blip)

get.description: Get all technologies in a quadrant

post.description: Create a new user technology assignment

get.description: Get all user technology assignments for a user
Get user technology assignment by ID

put.description: Update user technology assignment by ID

delete.description: Delete user technology assignment by ID
